categories.label: Brilliant
categories.definition:
A surprising reply that
turns the exchange around.

categories.label: Great
categories.definition:
The key response that
keeps the position steady.

categories.label: Best
categories.definition:
The strongest response
available in this moment.

categories.label: Excellent
categories.definition:
A strong reply, just
short of the best choice.

categories.label: Good
categories.definition:
A decent reply, but
leaves something on the table.

categories.label: Book
categories.definition:
A familiar opening
that sets the tone.

categories.label: Blunder
categories.definition:
A disastrous line that
hands over the advantage.

categories.label: Miss
categories.definition:
A chance to take control
goes completely unused.

categories.label: Mistake
categories.definition:
A costly reply that
weakens the position.

categories.label: Inaccuracy
categories.definition:
A questionable line that
gives away a little ground.

categories.label: Interesting
categories.definition:
A risky idea that could
pay off later.
